mapper.select: select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.query_param, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time, m.expand_fields from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role sur on rm.role_id = sur.role_id left join sys_role ro on sur.role_id = ro.role_id ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

select distinct m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.component_name, m.query_param, m.visible, m.`enable`, m.perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.is_link, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time, m.dynamic_path, m.expand_fields from sys_menu m left join sys_role_auth rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role sur on rm.role_id = sur.role_id left join sys_role ro on sur.role_id = ro.role_id left join sys_user u on sur.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and m.`enable` = 1 and ro.`enable` = 1 AND m.path IS NOT NULL AND rm.auth_value like '%=1%' order by m.parent_id, m.order_num DESC, m.menu_id
select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role sur on rm.role_id = sur.role_id

select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id left join sys_user_role sur on rm.role_id = sur.role_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = sur.role_id where m.enable = 1 and r.enable = 1 and sur.user_id = #{userId}
select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m left join sys_role_menu rm on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where m.status = '0' and rm.role_id = #{roleId}
